title: Minimum refractive index
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be n ≥ 2√3/3, derived from the condition for total internal reflection at the AB interface.

title: Critical angle condition
description: Important: Correctly applies the total internal reflection condition sin(θ_c) = 1/n at the AB interface, linking it to the given i=60°.

title: Geometry at disappearance
description: Important: Identifies that the right spot disappears when the refracted ray at AC is at the critical angle, leading to the geometric condition i₀ + r = 90°.

title: Application of Snell's Law
description: Important: Correctly applies Snell's Law (n sin r = sin i) at the AB interface for the given n=√3 to find the relationship for i₀.

title: Final angle i₀
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must give i₀ = 30°, obtained from solving the geometric and Snell's Law conditions.

title: Spot distance calculation
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must give the distance from A as R/3, derived from correct trigonometric analysis of the light path.

title: Path geometry analysis
description: Important: Correctly traces the light path from O to AC to AB to screen, using geometry of the 30-60-90 triangle AOC and quarter-circle.

title: Misapplied critical angle
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the critical angle condition is incorrectly applied at the AC interface instead of the AB interface.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if angles are in radians without conversion, or if the distance answer omits the factor R or has incorrect trigonometric factors.
